A translucent green water tank is visible near the front. The soleplate appears dark, likely non-stick coated. A power cord extends from the rear right. There is text/branding on the side of the white body.

The text on the lower white body is blurry and illegible. While likely just low resolution/compression, AI generators often fail to render crisp brand logos, so this warrants verification.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as an iron and not a similar appliance (e.g., garment steamer).
To analyze the illegible text on the side to determine if it is real brand text degraded by compression or AI-generated gibberish.
To ensure the translucent green tank merges logically with the white body and doesn't exhibit floating edges or fusion artifacts.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of the side text/logo
Physical connection between the green water reservoir and the main body

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's output. If the text is pure gibberish/nonsense characters, increase artifact severity. If it's just blurry but structurally plausible letters, keep severity low. Check if the green tank looks like a separate inserted layer or a physically integrated part.
